Job Description: Accounts Receivable Analyst

Position: Accounts Receivable Analyst Department: Finance Location: Lapa, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Reports to: Accounts Receivable Manager / Finance Manager

Job Summary

The Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for managing and processing incoming payments, ensuring accurate record-keeping, reconciling customer accounts, and supporting the company's cash flow management. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Payment Processing

  • Generate and issue customer invoices accurately and on time.
  • Record and reconcile incoming payments, ensuring correct allocation to customer accounts.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Process credit notes, adjustments, and refunds as necessary.

Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Reconcile customer accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Prepare and analyze aging reports to track overdue accounts.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities with necessary reports and reconciliations.

Collections & Customer Communication

  • Contact customers regarding overdue payments and negotiate payment arrangements when necessary.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships by addressing payment-related inquiries and disputes.
  • Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and financial regulations.
  • Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation and responding to inquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in accounts receivable, finance, or accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of accounts receivable processes, invoicing, and financial regulations.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and Microsoft Excel.

Descrição da vaga

Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. Na Origem não existem problemas “dos outros”, trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na gestão do planejamento tático operacional de atividades de manutenção e outras realizadas no ativo, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades, o monitoramento de cronogramas e recursos, a análise de indicadores de desempenho e a proposição de melhorias nos processos de planejamento.

  • Gestão do planejamento tático operacional da operação, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades de médio e curto prazo.
  • Monitorar a execução dos planos de manutenção (semanal, mensal, trimestral), avaliando o cumprimento de cronogramas, priorizações e recursos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na eficiência dos processos de planejamento, contribuindo com a padronização e automação de rotinas.
  • Análise crítica de indicadores de desempenho, visando identificar desvios, oportunidades e necessidades de correção.
  • Monitoramento de cronogramas, entregas, projetos e planos de ação, com identificação de pontos críticos e suporte à tomada de decisão para o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Interface com todas as áreas da empresa, promovendo comunicação fluida e alinhamento contínuo com as diretrizes estratégicas.
  • Elaboração de apresentações gerenciais e executivas periódicas, com foco em andamento, resultados e projeções.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento de metodologias de Manutenção, tais como Manutenção Produtiva Total (TPM), Manutenção Centrada na Confiabilidade (RCM) ou World Class Maintenance (WCM).
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de Gestão da Manutenção (CMMS) ou com módulos de Planejamento da Manutenção de sistemas ERP (ex: SAP PM, TOTVS).
  • Conhecimento do SAP MM.
  • Gestão de KPIs.
  • Gestão Orçamentária.
  • Habilidade para analisar dados.
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de Power BI.
  • Forte raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico.
  • Capacidade de gestão, liderança e influência sobre equipes.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação e bom relacionamento interpessoal.

Informações adicionais

VEM SER ORIGEM!

Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento do país mediante a integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Priorizamos a execução de estratégias e projetos responsáveis para promover um desenvolvimento mais homogêneo das regiões onde atuamos .

Nossa origem é feminina , com diferentes nacionalidades e culturas. Temos o compromisso com a diversidade e a pluralidade. Nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória cheia de energia com audácia, empreendedorismo, inovação e busca por oportunidades. Juntos, vamos apoiar na transição segura da matriz energética brasileira.

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

title: Engineer II, Sustainability
description:
Overview

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & writt en), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

  • Experiência em métricas envolvendo risco de crédito;
  • Experiência em análise quantitativa de risco;
  • Experiência em áreas de risco de mercado, crédito ou liquidez;

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia:

Gestão de CRM e Automação (Bitrix)

  • Investigar dados para identificar tendências, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria contínua em toda a jornada do cliente.

Operações de Vendas e Suporte Financeiro

  • Garantir a precisão e pontualidade no cálculo e fechamento das comissões do time comercial.
  • Auxiliar em processos de faturamento de contas especiais, assegurando a correta aplicação das regras de negócio e a comunicação entre áreas.

Requisitos:

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência comprovada na administração de CRMs, com forte domínio de Bitrix (gestão de pipelines, workflows, relatórios).
  • Domínio avançado de Excel / Google Sheets para análises, modelagem de dados e cálculos complexos.
  • Perfil altamente analítico, com uma capacidade natural de resolver problemas e uma atenção rigorosa aos detalhes.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Economia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas que possuam forte base analítica e de processos.
  • Mínimo de 2-3 anos de experiência em funções como Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence ou Análise de Dados.

Diferenciais que nos farão brilhar os olhos

  • Familiaridade com o uso de ferramentas de IA (ex: assistentes de IA em CRMs, ChatGPT/Gemini) para acelerar análises, gerar insights e otimizar tarefas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados e BI (Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio).

description:
Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.

title: Coordenador(a) de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos e Obras)
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

  • Estamos em busca de um Coordenador(a) de Segurança do Trabalho, com forte atuação em campo, para coordenar e garantir a excelência em Segurança do Trabalho nas obras de grande porte da NTS, envolvendo projetos de alto CAPEX, múltiplas contratadas e frentes simultâneas. Este profissional será responsável por assegurar a integridade operacional, a prevenção de riscos e o cumprimento dos requisitos legais e corporativos de SST nos canteiros de obras.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar presencialmente em campo, acompanhando frentes de serviço e garantindo conformidade com diretrizes corporativas de SST.
  • Coordenar a implementação de programas, normas, procedimentos e planos de Segurança do Trabalho aplicáveis às obras.
  • Realizar gestão de riscos (APR, PT, bloqueios, análise de atividades críticas etc.).
  • Acompanhar atividades críticas e atuar preventivamente na mitigação de riscos.
  • Conduzir investigações de incidentes e elaborar relatórios técnicos com planos de ação.
  • Engajar equipes operacionais, líderes e contratadas por meio de treinamentos, campanhas e diálogos de segurança.
  • Monitorar indicadores, elaborar análises e reportar periodicamente à liderança.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações regulatórias.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em SST junto às áreas de Engenharia, Operações, Projetos e contratadas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia com Pós-Graduação/Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Experiência sólida em obras de grande porte (civil, industrial, infraestrutura, montagem etc.).
  • Vivência com múltiplas contratadas e atividades simultâneas em campo.
  • Domínio das NRs aplicáveis a ambientes de obra.
  • Experiência com Projetos de CAPEX elevado.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em campo e viagens recorrentes.

Diferencial

  • Vivência no setor de gás natural.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com Gestor Mediato: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de otimização da taxa de conversão, atuando como elo estratégico entre dados, tecnologia e negócios. Sua missão é identificar oportunidades de melhoria nas jornadas digitais dos usuários, propor hipóteses fundamentadas em dados e executar testes que impulsionem resultados mensuráveis. Job Purpose

The Project Director provides day-to-day operational and strategic implementation leadership for the ASCEND-AI initiative, a multi-year, multi-institution collaboration between Howard University and Bowie State University focused on advancing AI literacy, responsible AI use, faculty development, curriculum infusion, and student application pathways. This role is responsible for translating the project vision and grant goals into coordinated action through faculty learning communities, collaborative workshops, curriculum module infusion, and student-facing activities. The Project Director ensures that activities are well planned, executed on schedule, and aligned with the approved workplan and budget, while supporting continuous improvement in partnership with project leadership and evaluators. The Project Director does not conduct evaluation but plays a critical role in enabling responsive implementation informed by evaluation findings.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Project Director is essential to ensuring ASCEND-AI’s ambitious goals translate into real, coordinated outcomes. By connecting planning to execution through faculty learning communities, curriculum infusion, workshops, and student application pathways, this role enables the project to move beyond theory into sustained impact across institutions.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Strategic Planning and Program Execution
  • Lead operational planning to ensure ASCEND-AI goals are achieved through:
    • Faculty Learning Community (FLC) sessions
    • Curriculum module infusion across disciplines
    • Three annual collaborative workshops
    • AI Use Competitions and student application activities
  • Translate high-level project goals into clear timelines, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Coordinate with PI and Co-PIs to ensure consistency between vision, planning, and implementation.
  • Ensure activities across Howard University and Bowie State University align in scope, pacing, and intent.

Faculty Learning Communities and Curriculum Infusion

  • Coordinate logistics, scheduling, and documentation for Faculty Learning Communities.
  • Support FLC facilitators in aligning sessions with project goals related to AI literacy, responsible AI use, and discipline-specific integration.
  • Track progress of curriculum module infusion across participating courses.
  • Ensure faculty development activities remain practical, accessible, and aligned with instructional realities.
  • Support knowledge sharing across institutions while allowing for contextual adaptation.
  • Ensure Faculty Learning Communities and curriculum infusion efforts are structured to support faculty success while minimizing additional administrative or instructional burden.

Workshops, Competitions, and Student Application Pathways

  • Plan and coordinate three annual collaborative workshops, including agendas, speakers, materials, and logistics.
  • Support implementation of AI Use Competitions and other applied learning experiences.
  • Ensure workshops and competitions reinforce project pillars such as human-in-the-loop AI use, ethical reasoning, and applied innovation.
  • Coordinate with partners and facilitators to maintain high-quality, well-run events.

Budget Monitoring and Financial Reporting

  • Monitor project expenditures monthly in coordination with the PI and institutional grants offices.
  • Prepare monthly budget summaries for PI review.
  • Generate quarterly financial reports for:
    • Howard University Grants Office
    • Bowie State University Grants Office
    • ASCEND-AI Advisory Board
  • Track alignment of spending with approved budget categories, including faculty stipends, staffing, curriculum development, workshops, evaluation services, and partnerships.
  • Identify potential budget or resource concerns early and support resolution.

Continuous Improvement and Coordination with Evaluation

  • Participate in quarterly data review meetings with:
    • PI and Co-PIs
    • Project Coordinator
    • FLC facilitators
    • Brick Rose Exchange evaluator
  • Support implementation adjustments based on formative evaluation findings while preserving evaluator independence.
  • Coordinate follow-up actions resulting from data-informed discussions.
  • Ensure documentation and implementation records support learning and accountability.

Cross-Institutional and Administrative Coordination

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between Howard University and Bowie State University.
  • Coordinate closely with the Project Coordinator at Bowie State University to manage inter-institutional timelines and logistics.
  • Maintain shared calendars, agendas, documentation, and communication channels.
  • Support dissemination activities and preparation of project documentation as needed.

Core Competencies

  • A self-starter who works well independently
  • Highly organized and proactive
  • Aligned with the vision and intent of ASCEND-AI
  • Reliable with strong follow-through
  • Tech-savvy and adaptable
  • Comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity
  • Skilled at keeping people, plans, and timelines moving forward

Minimum Requirements

Demonstrated experience managing complex, grant-funded projects, preferably in higher education, technology, workforce development, or innovation-focused initiatives. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Experience coordinating faculty, administrators, and external partners. Comfort working independently, taking initiative, and following through on tasks with minimal supervision. Strong communication and coordination skills.

$75,000-$85,000

A Empodera –Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional. Fundada em ****, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte. A Empodera é uma organização especializada em gênero e esporte e trabalha em prol do empoderamento de meninas e mulheres, em sua pluralidade, utilizando as práticas corporais e esportivas como ferramentas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades socioemocionais e a discussão de temas-chave para que as atendidas desenvolvam seu pleno potencial e exerçam os seus direitos.

description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of the SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reporting Structure

Reports to:

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO and Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaises with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking curious and intellectually proactive contributors who double‑check assumptions and play devil’s advocate, comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. This flexible, project‑based opportunity is ideal for analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills, and for those open to a part‑time, non‑permanent role.

About the Project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only – you’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

How to Get Started

Apply to this post to contribute to projects aligned with your skills on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you’ll need to complete a qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll become familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll directly shape how useful these models become for your future work.

title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company’s products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.

This role involves researching and segmenting target markets , identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement —to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect’s industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company’s offerings.

Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings , and document all interactions in the company’s CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.

An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious , able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills , both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

description:
Overview

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Reporting

Reports to: Driller

Supervision

Derrickhand, Pumphand, and Floorhand, Rover

Pre-requisite/Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/ Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid well control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and Maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well-being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Assistant Driller job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.
  • Norway Specific: Responsible to follow up on the working environment within the rig department.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • This is inclusive of:
    • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
    • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
    • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
    • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
    • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
    • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Demonstrate commitment and leadership in the protection of personnel, the environment, and assets.
  • Coach personnel in the understanding of applicable Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Ensure work is executed in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

    • Duties

    The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Assistant Driller, the Supervisor and the Assistant Driller will apply the rules of task planning (CAKES) to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

    Operations/Maintenance

    GENERAL DUTIES

    • Perform the drilling department’s daily checklists, i.e. QHSE checks, Derrick inspection, choke and mud manifold line ups, etc.
    • Maintain accurate BHA record of tubular and tool dimensions (i.e. internal and external diameter, fish neck, handling profiles and serial numbers etc.).
    • Calculate ton-miles on drilling line; maintain an accurate logbook and advise the Driller on the need to slip and cut.
    • Maintain an organized drilling equipment store and tubular and subs inventory.
    • Maintain proper communication with the Driller, Toolpusher, and other department heads.
    • Read and interpret various gauges and meters relating to the drilling operations; assist the Driller in maintaining records and logs.
    • Actively participate in pre-tour meeting with the drilling crew for all drilling operations.
    • Assist and relieve the Driller at the Driller’s console during drilling operations.
    • Assist with the preparation of equipment for impending drilling operations.
    • Organize and supervise the drilling crews for all operations.
    • Assist the Driller during an emergency or well control situation; assist in the well killing operations.
    • Assist in supervision of Preventive Maintenance carried out on drilling equipment.
    • Assist in supervision of repairs on drilling and associated equipment.
    • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
    • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
    • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e. Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
    • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
    • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
    • Participate daily in START process.
    • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
    • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
    • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
    • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
    • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
    • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.
    • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained onboard the rig.
    • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.
    • Participate in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure that they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to rig personnel; Apply continuous improvement process.
    • Assist in training to ensure that all personnel are competent to perform their allocated jobs.
    • Promote and maintain a good working relationship with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer Representatives.
    • Assist the Driller with the operation during the running and retrieving of marine risers, BOP and auxiliary equipment.

title: Sr. Technology Value Realization Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia required)
description:
Sr. Technology Value Realization Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia required)

Join to apply for the Sr. Technology Value Realization Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia required) role at aramco

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Technology Value Realization Specialist to join our Technology Strategy & Planning Department (TSPD). TSPD’s mission is to provide high-impact leadership and support across the technology life‑cycle, from strategy setting to value realization and sustainable growth, and partner with corporate and business stakeholders to integrate new technologies into the company’s strategies and investment plans.

Your primary role is to play a central part in the corporate stage‑gate and value realization process. You will provide leadership in the implementation, governance and sustainable capability needed to support full integration, application and continuous improvement of the technology stage‑gate process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the company-wide roll‑out of the Technology Realized Value (TRV) KPI validation and reporting process in partnership with Upstream, Downstream, Finance & Technology Organizations.
  • Manage and oversee the technology stage‑gate process, including ongoing implementation to support R&D, technology development, demonstration and deployment, and transition to operations in order to enable value realization from technology investments.
  • Provide leadership for scientists, engineers, and other business/functional specialists to enable de‑risking and go/no‑go decisions for R&D projects, ensuring technical‑commercial readiness prior to deployment and value realization.
  • Serve as an internal consultant for project teams on the development of robust business cases, deployment and value realization strategies, including partnering with technical, commercial and business leads to implement robust commercial review process to maximize financial return and strategic impact from R&D projects.
  • Assess technology stage‑gate practices and related activities across the Company, in order to maintain high‑standards and compliance with the Corporate Technology Development General Instructions.
  • Partner with R&D staff and stakeholders in technology, business and supporting functions, in order to ensure alignment across all areas and to support a smooth transition and adoption of the enhanced technology management processes.
  • Provide expert guidance to project teams and technology/executive management on related activities, including business case development, IP and commercial strategy, supply chain development, deployment plans, business models, value realization and related techno‑economics.
  • Support financial reporting for deployed technologies to ensure value capture.

Qualifications

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering. An advanced degree (MBA/Finance) is highly desirable.
  • You should have at least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in commercial technology development and value realization, preferably with some experience in oil and gas, chemicals and related industries.
  • You must possess subject matter expertise, business acumen and effective change management skills.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) systems, such as Planisware, Accolade, Clarity and similar software applications.
  • A proven track record of successfully working with multi‑cultural, cross‑functional teams, and developing productive working relationships.
  • Experience with Operation Excellence (OE) process development, implementation, including continuous improvement is also required.Advanced writing and verbal skills in English. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Full‑time

Job function

Consulting, Engineering, and Business Development

Industries

Energy Technology, Oil and Gas, and Chemical Manufacturing

title: Coordenador de Projetos & Negócios
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Coordenador de Projetos & Negócios abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso!

Sua missão:

Responsável por conduzir, implementar e gerir todas as fases do projeto de recondicionamento, reaproveitamento e reciclagem de veículos (caminhões) em fim de vida. Irá atuar de forma estratégica na definição de processos e, simultaneamente, na operação diária de catalogação, comercialização e gestão de peças.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na condução de projetos (startup), com amplo conhecimento no mercado de peças (novas ou usadas) e histórico de gestão em canais de venda digitais.
  • Domínio de plataformas de venda online (e-commerce próprio, Mercado Livre, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com componentes de veículos pesados (caminhões) será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.

title: Project Manager
description:
WELCOME TO SITA AtITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Overview

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting‑edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

As a Project Manager you will drive a variety of project initiatives that meets the needs of our customer base. This position offers an opportunity to work in a fast‑paced environment with colleagues and customers located worldwide. Success in this role means you pay attention to detail, be time sensitive, possess influencing skills and enjoy working with others of diverse backgrounds. As LAC team, we manage projects in Latin America and Caribbean countries, the Project Manager will be responsible for leading and delivering complex projects for airports and airline customers, ensuring operational continuity, regulatory compliance, and high service quality in mission‑critical aviation environments.

What You Will Do

  • Lead end‑to‑end project delivery, managing initiatives from inception through successful closure.
  • Manage projects of varying size and complexity while driving scope, schedule, and quality outcomes.
  • Proactively identify, mitigate, and manage project risks, issues, and change requests.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross‑functional and geographically distributed project teams.
  • Track project progress against plans and take corrective actions to address deviations.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders, management, and customers to ensure alignment.
  • Maintain strong customer focus, partnering closely to meet project goals and satisfaction targets.
  • Produce clear, accurate project documentation, including plans, status reports, governance updates, and lessons learned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Formal Project Management training; PMP certification is recommended but not mandatory.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a project management role; experience in the Air Transport industry is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent customer communication skills in English; fluency in Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of IT services, including Network and Server operations.
  • Proven experience managing multiple projects and programs of varying sizes, complexities, budgets, and deliverables in a commercial environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, time management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders effectively.

What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.
Flex‑Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

description:
Nós movemos o mercado financeiro para o futuro, impulsionando negócios e potencializar a economia do país. Com o maior hub de dados e informações do cenário financeiro brasileiro, lideramos iniciativas que realmente importam: defendemos os interesses dos nossos parceiros e investidores, fornecemos ferramentas analíticas e dados, educamos investidores e certificamos profissionais, além de estabelecermos regras para as instituições do mercado financeiro e de capitais. .

Como Analista de DevSecops Sênior para integrar nosso time e atuar na proteção, monitoramento e evolução da segurança da informação em ambientes críticos. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência sólida em segurança e deseja trabalhar com práticas modernas como DevSecOps , essa oportunidade é para você.

  • Implementar e manter políticas e controles de segurança em ambientes corporativos;
  • Realizar análise de vulnerabilidades e propor medidas corretivas;
  • Atuar na integração de práticas DevSecOps em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Monitorar incidentes e responder a eventos de segurança;
  • Prestar apoio técnico em segurança para equipes internas e projetos;
  • Emitir pareceres de segurança sobre soluções, arquiteturas e mudanças propostas;
  • Implementar ferramentas de segurança, garantindo sua correta configuração e integração;
  • Conduzir projetos de segurança, desde o planejamento até a execução, alinhando com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e operações para garantir segurança desde a concepção até a entrega;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e recomendações estratégicas para gestão de riscos.
  • Formação - Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou cursos correlatos.
  • Sólida atuação em Cibersegurança corporativa;
  • Experiência prática em DevSecOps (integração de segurança em CI/CD, automação de testes de segurança).
  • Experiência com análise de logs e alertas de SIEM
  • Controles de segurança em nuvem (AWS preferencialmente).
  • Ferramentas de segurança: scanners de vulnerabilidade (Nessus, Qualys), ferramentas de SAST/DAST (SonarQube, OWASP ZAP), etc
  • Processos DevSecOps: automação de testes de segurança, integração contínua com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, e uso de pipelines seguros.
  • Linguagens para automação (Python, Shell) e scripts para integração.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas.
  • Perfil analítico e foco em resultados.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, ou equivalentes.
  • Certificação relacionada a DevSecOps será um diferencial.

Conheça nossos benefícios

  • Vale Refeição R$ 1.177,00;
  • Vale Alimentação R$ 925,00;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental de 6 meses para todos os colaboradores da ANBIMA;
  • Auxílio Funeral;
  • Parcerias, Day Off de aniversário e muito mais...

Local de trabalho

Nosso escritório fica na região do centro do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos trabalhando de forma hibrida, escritório (3x por semana) e home-office (2x por semana).

Muito prazer, somos a ANBIMA – Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais. Falamos em nome de instituições como bancos, gestoras, corretoras, distribuidoras e administradoras. Temos a missão de fortalecer a representação do setor e apoiar a evolução de um mercado de capitais capaz de financiar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil e influenciar o mercado global.

Somos protagonistas da evolução da indústria de investimentos, trazendo impacto e legado positivos ao nosso país. Se você tem sede de aprender a impactar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil, a ANBIMA é para você!
